title: Design System: CouponPush Amazon festival store trial

display.purpose: Campaign name; source overrides at 850px and 599px.

offer-action.purpose: View offer and View deal use Manrope 800 at 14px desktop; product-card action is 12px on mobile.

motion.name: movement-curve
motion.purpose: Shared hero, indicator, arrow, card and image movement easing.

motion.name: active-filter-indicator
motion.purpose: 1px base width, 2px height; ResizeObserver supplies active button translateX and scaleX dimensions.

motion.name: offer-action-color
motion.purpose: Transparent action text changes from #a54600 to #7c3300.

motion.name: offer-action-arrow
motion.purpose: Arrow shifts 4px on hover and visible focus.

motion.name: card-category-hover
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer hover lifts cards/categories 3px. Categories also transition background-color .24s ease.

motion.name: product-image-hover
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer hover translates product image up 2px and scales 1.035.

motion.name: category-image-hover
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer hover translates image up 3px and rotates -2deg.

motion.name: offer-row-hover
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer hover warms border to #e3c7a2 and surface to #fffdfa.

motion.name: rail-scroll
motion.value: smooth; instant JS behavior when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
motion.purpose: Rail scrollBy and category scrollIntoView. Rail CSS declares scroll-behavior:smooth.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Route, descendants and pseudo-elements remove motion. Hover transforms may still take their final state immediately.

scope.status: Implemented local trial; not deployed; no pixel-identity certification.
scope.authority: Route-local record. Shared public shell remains incumbent.
scope.headerException: body:has(.page) narrows only the shared header grid from 761px through 1100px while this route is present.

focus.search: outline: 2px solid #a54600; outline-offset: 2px on the label through focus-within

assetNotes: Existing inventory imagery is reused; no generated raster was added.
Amazon mark is adapted from Font Awesome Free brands/amazon.svg. Shipped CC BY 4.0 attribution: public/assets/festival-2026/amazon-mark.LICENSE.txt.
new store ui.png is development-only visual reference and is not shipped.

Route typography self-hosts CouponPush Manrope normal variable weights 400–800 from public/fonts/manrope-variable.woff2 and manrope-latin-ext-variable.woff2, with Manrope-OFL.txt. Latin-ext includes the rupee character. Origin: D:/Cpush/tmp/manrope-font-origin.json.
Merchant identity adds a CSS dashed frame rotated -5deg and a decorative 16px inline SVG sparkle; no raster asset was generated.
previewNotes: Snippets demonstrate visual states; no catalog content, filter persistence or API behavior is implemented by this sidecar.
The offer-row preview omits its decorative image column. Runtime four-column layout remains authoritative in DESIGN.md and the CSS Module.
Tonal ramps are synthesized OKLCH swatch-preview metadata, not source tokens or approved additional UI colors. The frontmatter alone owns the actual source palette.
The offer-type preview shows the real pre-measurement border fallback. Runtime uses ResizeObserver dimensions and a translateX/scaleX indicator; the static preview does not reproduce that JavaScript.
Preview text uses the route font family registered by the CSS Module. The arrow uses a self-contained SVG equivalent; runtime retains its incumbent icon delivery.
extensions.evidenceStatus: Latest refinement verification: D:/Cpush/tmp/amazon-store-polish-check.json. No recorded errors or overflow at 1440, 810, 768, 390 and 320px. Checks cover measured indicator, loaded Manrope, transparent offer/deal actions, reduced motion, preserved interactions and unchanged regular store routes. Earlier amazon-store-png-final artifacts remain baseline history. This documentation pass did not run browser checks.

components.css: .ds-offer-row{transition:border-color .22s ease,background-color .22s ease;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(170px,1.2fr) minmax(150px,1fr) minmax(170px,.9fr);align-items:center;gap:22px;min-height:130px;padding:18px 22px;border:1px solid #e9edf2;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;color:#14171c;font-family:"CouponPush Manrope",var(--font-primary,"Satoshi",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif);}.ds-bank-label{display:inline-flex;margin-bottom:8px;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:5px;background:#edf4ff;color:#285cc1;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2}.ds-offer-row h3{margin:0;font-size:22px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-offer-row p{margin:5px 0 0;color:#434b58;font-size:15px;line-height:1.4}.ds-offer-description{color:#535c6b;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}.ds-row-action{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:40px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:#a54600;text-decoration:none;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;transition:color .18s ease}.ds-row-action:hover{background:transparent;color:#7c3300}.ds-action-arrow{transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.65,.3,1)}.ds-row-action:is(:hover,:focus-visible) .ds-action-arrow{transform:translateX(4px)}.ds-offer-row summary{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:34px;color:#3c4553;list-style:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px}.ds-offer-row details p{margin:4px 0 8px;color:#596273;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}.ds-offer-row :is(a,summary):focus-visible{outline:3px solid #a54600;outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:599px){.ds-offer-row{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px;padding:16px}.ds-row-action,.ds-offer-row summary{min-height:44px}}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-offer-row:hover{border-color:#e3c7a2;background:#fffdfa}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-offer-row,.ds-row-action,.ds-action-arrow{transition:none!important}}

components.name: FAQ disclosure
components.description: Native disclosure with a fine outline and uncropped answer.
components.html:
Does CouponPush sell these products?

No. CouponPush helps you compare offers and sends you to Amazon India to buy. Amazon and the seller handle payment, delivery, returns and warranty. CouponPush is independent of Amazon.

narrative.overview:
This route records a white, compact merchant storefront derived from the supplied store PNG and implemented around the real Amazon festival inventory. Dark Manrope headings, fine gray borders, transparent dark-orange shopping actions and a black merchant link establish a clear scan from campaign identity to offers, products, categories and conditions.

This is an implemented local trial for /store/amazon-great-indian-festival-2026/, not a deployment record or a certified pixel-identical clone. The shared CouponPush navigation, footer and global brand assets remain incumbent; this document has no authority over other routes.
keyCharacteristics: White surfaces and fine borders rather than raised cards.
Strong, compact headings above restrained gray supporting copy.
Transparent dark-orange offer actions, black merchant navigation and a gliding orange active-filter indicator.
Inventory-derived imagery, counts and categories with source terms available.

rules.name: The Action Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use transparent dark-orange text for View offer and View deal; retain orange fill for code-copy and recovery controls, orange for the active offer-type underline, and black for the merchant visit action.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate route surfaces with borders and pale fills; the route module declares no box shadows.

rules.name: The Route Boundary Rule
rules.body: Apply this system only to the Amazon festival route. Preserve shared shell ownership and the data and behavior contracts.

dos: Do preserve real inventory, source links, eligibility notes, fallback states and native disclosures.
Do keep the horizontal deal rail and expanded grid as two views of the same filtered inventory.
Do keep saved deals on this device and keep the removed wishlist collection absent.
Do retain route-scoped styles and the incumbent public navigation and footer.
Do reuse actual inventory images with contained sizing and an unavailable-image fallback.
donts: Don't import illustrative coupon codes, ratings, verification claims, shopper totals or category counts from the reference PNG.
Don't ship the development reference PNG as page artwork or add generated raster replacements.
Don't promote this trial into a product-wide design system or claim deployment or certified pixel identity.
Don't combine exchange credits, future cashback and bank eligibility into an unconditional payable price.
